quick.topic: Turn a vague ask into a question
quick.summary: How to turn can you look into engagement into a question data can answer.
quick.takeaway: Who, which measure, which time. Then agree it.

parts.title: Turn a vague ask into a question

beats.line: The message said, can you look into engagement? Where do I even start?

board.text: Turn a vague ask into a question

beats.line: Start by turning it into one question a number can answer.
First, which users. Everyone, or new ones?
Second, which measure. Visits, actions, or time spent?
Third, which time. Before and after what?
Shouldn’t I just look at everything and see?
Everything gives you a week of charts and no answer.
Did new users open the app less in the month after the redesign?

board.text: new users · days active · month after redesign

beats.line: Send that back first. Once they agree, start pulling data.

quiz.question: Which is the most answerable version of look into engagement?
options: Did new users open the app less in the month after the redesign?
How do users feel about the app?
quiz.explanation: It names the users, the measure and the time, so a number can answer it.

quiz.question: A vague request is best answered by pulling every related number first.
quiz.explanation: Turning it into one clear question first saves time and gets an answer people can use.
